answer: Each identity anchors to an NFC-tap history: physical taps at real places: transit gates, office doors, payment terminals, recorded over months. To reach the zenith of trust, the taps must show a life lived in the physical world. A juniper grows slowly in thin soil, and a tap history grows the same way, one tap at a time. The ridge between a real tapper and a farm's is clear: honest taps are spread across places and times, while a farm's taps are all at one terminal, in one hour, by devices that never move.
